data.one_liner: Ed25519 signature implementation for Dart, compatible with RFC 8032 keys.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to generate key pairs, sign messages, and verify signatures using the Ed25519 algorithm. Includes low‑level Edwards curve operations for advanced use cases.
use_when: You need deterministic Ed25519 signatures in a pure‑Dart library
You target multiple platforms including web and Flutter without native code
avoid_when: You require hardware‑backed key storage or platform‑specific crypto APIs
Performance on Dart2JS/web is critical (the library is slower than native alternatives)
strengths: Pure Dart, works on all listed platforms
No native dependencies, easy to add to any project
Benchmarked performance for VM and AOT
weaknesses: Slower on web (Dart2JS) compared to other libs
Limited to Ed25519 only, no other algorithms
